facts.summary: Mixed Phase 1 dose-escalation data, 26% response rate · Phase 1 · PYX-201 in solid tumors · not yet approved
facts.indication: advanced solid tumors (HNSCC, ovarian, breast, NSCLC, sarcoma and others)

evidence.summary: 26% ORR observed at Identified Dose Range across 6* solid tumor types (n=31) with 50% ORR in lead indication HNSCC
evidence.safety: PYX-201 well-tolerated with low discontinuation rate well-positioned for front-line IO combinations
